definition.description: Presence of mucositis (inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes) prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether mucositis is documented as being present or absent in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the clinical records do not explicitly mention the presence or absence of mucositis.
definition.name: mucositis_presence

definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether myelosuppression is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if myelosuppression is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: myelosuppression

definition.description: The presence of a documented history of myocardial infarction.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if there is any documented diagnosis, medical history entry, or clinical note stating the patient has experienced a myocardial infarction prior to the pretreatment period.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the medical record contains no mention of myocardial infarction or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: myocardial_infarction_presence

definition.description: The regional lymph node stage (N stage) of the lung cancer as part of the TNM classification system.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the N-stage identifier (e.g., N0, N1, N2, N3) from the cancer staging documentation. If reported as pN or cN, extract the N value.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the N-stage is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: n_stage

definition.description: Napsin A expression as determined by immunohistochemical (IHC) staining of tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of Napsin A immunohistochemistry from the pathology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if Napsin A staining was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: napsin_a_expression

definition.description: The severity of nausea experienced by the patient, typically graded using the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) or Patient-Reported Outcomes version of CTCAE (PRO-CTCAE).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric grade of nausea severity (1-4) from the patient record. If documented as a range (e.g., 'grade 1-2'), extract the maximum value of the range. Map descriptive terms to numeric grades: Mild = 1, Moderate = 2, Severe = 3, Life-threatening/Disabling = 4.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if nausea is not mentioned, is explicitly documented as absent, or if the severity is not specified.
definition.name: nausea_severity

definition.description: Presence of necrotic fluid in the clinical specimen or anatomical site.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify any mention of necrotic fluid in the patient's pretreatment records; categorize as 'Present' if identified as present or obvious, and 'Absent' otherwise.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if necrotic fluid is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: necrotic_fluid_presence

definition.description: Presence of neurological symptoms in the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's record indicates the presence of neurological symptoms, including mentions of 'new neurologic changes', 'neurologic compromise', or 'neurologic symptoms develop'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if there is no mention of neurological symptoms or if they are explicitly denied.
definition.name: neurological_symptoms_presence

definition.description: The ratio of the absolute neutrophil count to the absolute lymphocyte count, used as a marker of systemic inflammation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly reported neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) from laboratory results. If the ratio is not explicitly provided but absolute neutrophil and lymphocyte counts are available in the CBC differential, the value is the quotient of absolute neutrophils divided by absolute lymphocytes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if neither the NLR nor both necessary components (absolute neutrophils and absolute lymphocytes) are documented.
definition.name: neutrophil_to_lymphocyte_ratio

definition.description: Presence of night sweats as a systemic symptom.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record documents the occurrence of night sweats or general sweats.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: night_sweats

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
